cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

mechanism: Copy a taxi driver's receipt mark without knowing it cancels a fare, then price a lift in petrol and increasingly demanding reconciliation.
confusable: Not ordinary fare haggling: the copied bookkeeping error must produce a payment concession A uses to press a growing emotional debt.
comparison: Lift fare and repaired contact differ from clothing loan and public respect for taste.
seedUse: Retains lift/petrol/why calls stopped; introduces cancelled-receipt cross and an offer to settle fare.
